response.sql: WITH station_stats AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation) SELECT observstation, avg_bandwidth_usage, telescope_count, telescope_count * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(telescope_count) FROM station_stats) AS telescope_count_ratio FROM station_stats ORDER BY telescope_count_ratio DESC LIMIT 10;
